title: TS-40a Move shared secrets into ControlPlane; MIGRATING gate and pre-flight
description: Part of the flip (chatticus-6f27c5). Before any traffic moves: (1) move the invoke and operator secrets that ControlPlane imports from ChatticusThinTurn exports (see the TS-51 comment) into the ControlPlane stack or runtime Secrets Manager reads, so ThinTurn can be deleted; (2) verify the MIGRATING state item and the 503 write gate exist from TS-38 (conversation/src/migration, domain write gate) and add conversation/bin/preflight.ts (no active turns, queues empty, no host start in flight) with vitest and a mutation check; (3) conversation/bin/purge-legacy-items.ts for day 14 (design 7.1 step 5). Read docs/TYPESCRIPT_CONTROL_PLANE.md 2.7 and 7.1.
